name: MedStation
verdict: Over the last 28 days MedStation generated 130 leads at a $6.91 CPL entirely through Meta (Google Ads contributed $0), but the biggest concern is a 42.74% spike in CPL week-over-week alongside an 8% drop in leads, likely driven by the top campaign "MDST-WES-WHTAPP" concentrating $802.24 of the $897.65 spend with diminishing efficiency. GBP actions also fell 60% in the last 7 days, signaling reduced local discovery that warrants immediate attention.

performance.verdict: CPL spike is real and accelerating; SOW execution lag is the bigger risk.

findings.text: 10 of 10 SOW milestones are overdue (earliest due 2026-07-31); no campaigns, CRM, landing pages, or LSA are confirmed live per plan.

CPL spiked 42.74% week-over-week to an implied ~$9.85 last 7d; 3-day signal (Oct 7–9: $169.45 spend, 15 leads) vs prior 3 days (Oct 4–6: $70.53 spend, 8 leads) shows spend doubled while leads-per-dollar fell sharply.
MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP consumed $802.24 of $897.65 (89%) 28-day spend; single-campaign concentration means no budget escape valve when efficiency decays.
GBP actions fell 60% week-over-week; last 2 days in series show 0 GBP actions despite 436 impressions over 26 days — local discovery drop is not explained by paid activity.
GA4 sessions doubled (+102%) while leads fell 8% and GHL pipeline is null — 2,308 sessions producing 0 tracked GA4 conversions suggests tracking is broken or intake is not closing the loop.

suggestions.text: Hold current Meta budget; watch CPL over next 3 days before any scale — confirmed decay needs 3-day reversal signal first.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta CPL spiked 42.74% week-over-week with spend up 31% and leads down 8%. The 3-day signal (Oct 7–9) shows $169.45 spent for only 15 leads vs $70.53 for 8 leads in the prior 3 days — efficiency is declining as budget rises. Hold the daily budget at its current ~$42/day level and re-check on 2026-10-13. Success condition: CPL returns below the 28-day baseline of $6.91 for at least 3 consecutive days before any scale is approved.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 10 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; no paid scale is defensible without stack test and attribution live.
suggestions.monday_update: All 10 SOW milestones are overdue, the earliest by 71 days (due 2026-07-31). GA4 shows 2,308 sessions with 0 tracked conversions and GHL pipeline data is null, meaning no lead-to-appointment path is measurable. Nacer to provide written status on each milestone — pre-launch stack test, Como→GHL migration, Meta CAPI, landing pages, GBP triage, LSA, search campaigns, reactivation sequences, and Phase 1 close — by 2026-10-13. Success check: at least the stack test and GHL pipeline are confirmed live with data flowing before any budget increase is approved.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP profile for suppression or listing issue; 0 actions last 2 days with non-zero impressions signals a listing or category problem.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped 60% week-over-week and hit 0 for the last 2 days in the series despite the Weston profile recording 436 impressions over 26 days. This is not explained by paid activity. Check the MedStation Weston listing for suppression flags, category changes, or a suspended state in Google Business Profile Manager. Success check: GBP actions return to a 7-day average above 3/day by 2026-10-17, confirmed in the next performance run.
